source.author: verg
source.text: Stant arae circum, et crines effusa sacerdos ter centum tonat ore deos, Erebumque Chaosque, tergeminamque Hecaten, tria virginis ora Dianae.
source.text_original: Stant arae circum, et crines effusa sacerdos / ter centum tonat ore deos, Erebumque Chaosque, / tergeminamque Hecaten, tria virginis ora Dianae.
source.text_english: Altars stand around, and the priestess, her hair loosened, thunders with her mouth the three hundred gods, Erebus and Chaos, and triple Hecate, and the three faces of the maiden Diana.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: et quem fama genus non est decepta Lyaei Phlias immissus patrios de vertice crines.
reuse.text_original: et quem fama genus non est decepta Lyaei / Phlias immissus patrios de vertice crines.
reuse.text_english: and Phlias, whom unerring rumor does not wrongly reckon among the family of Lyaeus, was sent down with his ancestral hair from the summit of his head.
